sections.process: The original 14,999-row CSV yielded 9,998 valid labelled customers after excluding 5,000 missing targets and one malformed target. Customer ID served as the identifier. Stratified sampling with seed 2203 allocated 6,999 records to training and 2,999 to the holdout. Twelve predictors excluded education and weekly work hours. Five stratified folds estimated training performance. Each fold fitted its own imputation and nominal-vocabulary preprocessing; logistic regression also fitted dummy encoding and standardisation. Validation and test records received only the training-fitted transformations. Neither oversampling nor test-based parameter changes were used (Kohavi, 1995).
sections.recommendations:
The bank should withhold these classifiers from operational lending. Both classified every test customer as non-default, including all 318 customers who had defaulted. Their 89.40% accuracy therefore adds no default-detection value at the tested rule. Logistic regression provides modest ranking evidence, but that does not establish an acceptable screening threshold (Saito & Rehmsmeier, 2015).

A further study should examine repayment timing, instalment burden, verified disposable income, loan terms and changes in financial buffers. Check whether each feature was available before the outcome. Investigate the observed age, capital-gain, income and borrowing-purpose associations through uncertainty estimates and subgroup analysis; avoid assuming that they identify causes.

The forest produced only non-default leaves. Investigate whether more informative, timely predictors improve discrimination in a new study with a predefined training protocol. Specify expected-loss and calibration criteria before selecting thresholds, and reserve a genuinely new cohort for evaluation. The existing holdout cannot support another independent model-selection claim.

Qualified staff should assess verified affordability, document reasons and review disputed records while predictive work remains experimental.
sections.ethics:
The main ethical limitation is the failure to identify any default in the test set. Presenting overall accuracy as a dependable risk assessment would conceal this failure. Customers and the bank could bear the consequences of unsuitable credit, so the current model should not determine eligibility.

This process omitted education, race, gender and geographic origin from its predictors. Those omissions do not demonstrate fairness: income, age and financial variables may still encode unequal opportunities or act as proxies (Mehrabi et al., 2019). Before any future deployment, assess subgroup recall, false-positive rates and calibration with adequate observations and uncertainty estimates. Examine competing fairness definitions in the context of the lending objective, rather than claiming that one metric proves equitable treatment.

Limit data collection to relevant, verified information, restrict access and establish a justified retention period. Explain the role and limitations of the model to applicants. Provide a route to correct inaccurate inputs and appeal decisions, with a responsible human reviewer who can reconsider evidence.

Maintain records of training data, preprocessing, model versions and subsequent decisions. Monitor changes in outcomes and population composition, and suspend use when predefined performance requirements fail. The observed coefficients describe conditional associations; they do not justify treating an individual as inherently risky or safe.
sections.predictors: The native logistic model assigned negative weights to standardised age (-0.142), capital gain (-0.096), income above $250,000 (-0.174) and small-business loan purpose (-0.235). These associations depend on coding and the remaining predictors; they are neither causal effects nor reliable grounds for accepting applicants. Every tree in the 50-tree forest was a non-default leaf, so the forest supplied no split-based variable importance (Breiman, 2001). The logistic operator uses myKLR, and its exported weights should be interpreted within that implementation rather than attributed to a separately estimated conventional regression (RapidMiner, n.d.).
sections.comparison: Cross-validation gave logistic regression AUC 0.601 and random forest AUC 0.500. Neither detected defaults, leaving the primary native F1 criterion unresolved. Logistic regression was retained only for its secondary ranking evidence before the holdout. Among 2,999 test customers, both models achieved 89.40% accuracy and zero default recall; every prediction was non-default. Logistic regression AUC was 0.595, while forest AUC remained 0.500. Native precision and F1 were undefined, and count-derived F1 was zero. The 50-tree ensemble provided no advantage at this operating rule (Breiman, 2001). Banks should deploy neither model. Class imbalance makes overall accuracy inadequate, and default-focused performance must guide a new, independently validated study (Saito & Rehmsmeier, 2015). No holdout-driven retuning or reselection occurred (Kohavi, 1995).
